title: King John seals Magna Carta
note: The king and rebel barons met at Runnymede.

title: Constantinople falls to the Ottomans
note: The capture ended a siege of 53 days.

title: The battle of Sekigahara is fought
note: The battlefield lies in what is now Japan’s Gifu Prefecture.

title: Shakespeare’s First Folio is published
note: The collection appeared seven years after the playwright’s death.

title: Congress adopts the US Declaration of Independence
note: Delegates began signing the parchment copy in August.

title: Haiti declares independence
note: The declaration renounced French rule.

title: The first signatories sign the Treaty of Waitangi
note: Māori chiefs and a representative of the British Crown signed at Waitangi.

title: London’s Great Exhibition opens
note: The Crystal Palace in Hyde Park housed the international exhibition.

title: The Meiji Restoration returns power to Japan’s emperor
note: Japan’s government and industry would change rapidly during the Meiji era.

title: The first modern Olympics open in Athens
note: Spectators filled the rebuilt Panathenaic Stadium.

title: Orville Wright pilots the Flyer’s first flight
note: The flight lasted twelve seconds.

title: The Rite of Spring premieres in Paris
note: The Ballets Russes performed to music by Igor Stravinsky.

title: Gandhi sets out on the Salt March
note: The marchers traveled on foot to Dandi to challenge the British salt laws.

title: India gains independence
note: Independence preceded the establishment of the republic.

title: Sputnik enters orbit
note: Earth’s first artificial satellite was about the size of a beach ball.

title: Yuri Gagarin orbits Earth
note: The Vostok flight took him around the planet once.

title: Apollo 11 lands on the Moon
note: Eagle touched down in the Sea of Tranquility.

title: The Sydney Opera House officially opens
note: Its first opera production had already taken place the previous month.

title: The Berlin Wall’s checkpoints open
note: Crowds crossed at Bornholmer Straße that night.

title: Hubble launches aboard Discovery
note: The crew deployed the telescope the next day.

title: Nelson Mandela takes office as president
note: His inauguration followed South Africa’s first national election open to voters of all races.

title: Dolly the sheep is born
note: Dolly was born in Scotland; her birth was announced the following year.
